business_summary: The Hershey Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of confectionery products and pantry items in the United States and internationally. It operates through three segments: North America Confectionery, North America Salty Snacks, and International. The company offers chocolate and non-chocolate confectionery products; gum and mint refreshment products, including mints, chewing gums, and bubble gums; protein bars; pantry items, such as baking ingredients, toppings, beverages, and sundae syrups; and snack items comprising spreads, bars, snack bites, mixes, popcorn, and pretzels. It provides its products primarily under the Hershey's, Reese's, Kisses, Jolly Rancher, Almond Joy, Brookside, barkTHINS, Cadbury, Good & Plenty, Heath, Kit Kat, Payday, Rolo, Twizzlers, Sour Strips, Whoppers, York, Ice Breakers, Breath Savers, Bubble Yum, Lily's, SkinnyPop, Pirates Booty, Dot's Homestyle Pretzels, and ONE Bar brands, as well as under the Pelon Pelo Rico, IO-IO, and Sofit brands. The company markets and sells its products to wholesale distributors, chain grocery stores, mass merchandisers, chain drug stores, vending companies, wholesale clubs, convenience stores, dollar stores, concessionaires, and department stores. It exports its products in approximately 65 countries worldwide. The Hershey Company was founded in 1894 and is based in Hershey, Pennsylvania.
business_summary_ko: Hershey Company는 자회사와 함께 미국 및 해외에서 제과 제품 및 식료품 저장실 품목의 제조 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. North America Confectionery, North America Salty Snacks 및 International의 세 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 초콜릿 및 초콜릿이 아닌 제과 제품을 제공합니다. 민트, 츄잉껌, 풍선껌을 포함한 껌 및 민트 다과 제품; 단백질 바; 베이킹 재료, 토핑, 음료 및 순대 시럽과 같은 식품 저장실 품목; 스프레드, 바, 스낵 바이트, 믹스, 팝콘 및 프레첼로 구성된 스낵 품목. 주로 Hershey's, Reese's, Kisses, Jolly Rancher, Almond Joy, Brookside, 껍질THINS, Cadbury, Good & Plenty, Heath, Kit Kat, Payday, Rolo, Twizzlers, Sour Strips, Whoppers, York, Ice Breakers, Breath Savers, Bubble Yum, Lily's, SkinnyPop, Pirates Booty, Dot's Homestyle Pretzels 및 ONE으로 제품을 제공합니다. 바 브랜드는 물론 Pelon Pelo Rico, IO-IO 및 Sofit 브랜드도 포함됩니다. 회사는 도매 유통업체, 체인 식료품점, 대량 판매점, 체인 약국, 자판기 회사, 도매 클럽, 편의점에 제품을 판매하고 있습니다.
